purpose: Validation-only fresh-seed transfer of the prediction-connected AutoCon representation fusion on the stronger single-scan MambaTSv3 backbone.
research_question: Does direct, zero-initialized AutoCon representation-to-forecast fusion improve the MambaTSv3 AutoCon control on METR-LA and PEMS-BAY H12 without adding a second Mamba scan?
architecture: MambaTSv3 uses one shared patch-token Mamba-1 scan, low-rank cross-variable context, persistence head, and AutoCon representation. The treatment adds only a zero-initialized low-rank representation-to-forecast residual; the same representation is optimized by the AutoCon contrastive objective and consumed by the forecast head.
evidence_boundary: All jobs use skip_test=true. No held-out test metrics are generated, read, or used for selection.
claim_boundary: A pass licenses only a separately registered external-baseline confirmation; it does not establish universal accuracy, causal AutoCon effect, or speed.
prelaunch_gates: keep AutoCon enabled in both arms
keep skip_test=true and no prediction artifacts

phases.name: fusion_off_h12
phases.purpose: Exact MambaTSv3 AutoCon control with representation fusion disabled.

phases.name: fusion_on_h12
phases.purpose: One-factor treatment: direct zero-initialized AutoCon representation-to-forecast residual.

accuracy_gate.fusion_vs_control: Treatment must lower mean validation MSE on both datasets, win at least 2/3 paired seeds per dataset, and have no paired degradation above 2%.
accuracy_gate.external_context: After this paired gate, reuse or rerun same-source strong baselines; candidate must be within 2% of the strongest baseline on both datasets.

comparison_contract.resource_gate: Only after accuracy pass, measure exact-shape prediction-only latency and parameters; the fusion must not be slower than the registered 10% budget.

stopping_rules: Do not change fusion rank, initialization, seeds, or budget after launch.
Stop before external confirmation and test release if either dataset fails the paired gate.
Do not claim AutoCon causal improvement from this two-arm screen alone.
